_comment: Config for the weekly sharded mutation run.
WHAT IS COVERED, AND WHY NOT EVERYTHING. `include` is the logic tier:
RunnerCore (the grading core, compiled natively AND to wasm), Core (models,
language dispatch, pattern rendering) and Worker (submission normalization,
job lifecycle). Together ~16k LOC, ~2,650 mutants, ~12h serial, which shards
to well under an hour of wall clock.
APIServer is deliberately EXCLUDED and should stay excluded. It is 94k LOC
-- 15,681 mutants -- and its mutants must be graded by APITests, the slowest
suite, so it is ~1,712h serial: about 96% of the total cost of the tree. The
value is also lowest there: it is overwhelmingly Vapor route wiring, Leaf
rendering and Fluent models, where mutants are dominated by pagination bounds
and deleted log lines. Triage cost scales with SURVIVORS, not mutants, and a
report nobody reads is worse than no report because it looks like coverage.
testArgs grades every mutant with CoreTests + WorkerTests and skips APITests.
That is a deliberate trade: including APITests would multiply per-mutant cost
by roughly 25x. The cost is that Core code reached ONLY through APITests will
show false survivors -- which is why the report tells the reader to verify
before acting, and why nothing here is a gate.
